Task: Initialize Expo project with Expo Router and TypeScript
Acceptance Criteria: Expo app runs locally; TypeScript configured; Expo Router file-based routing works
Cursor Prompt: Create a new Expo project for Grip Kitchen using Expo Router and TypeScript. Configure React Native Web. Use the app name Grip Kitchen. Set up the initial folder structure with app/ routes for: today (dashboard), pantry, recipes, planner, shop, settings. Add a root layout with placeholder screens for each tab.

Task: Configure NativeWind or Tailwind for responsive styling
Acceptance Criteria: Tailwind/NativeWind works on web and native; test class renders correctly
Cursor Prompt: Set up NativeWind (or Tailwind CSS with React Native Web) for Grip Kitchen. Configure theme tokens for: bold modern mono aesthetic, soft rounded corners (8-12px), modern sans font (Inter or DM Sans), functional status colors (green in-stock, red missing, amber expiring), and one brand accent for primary actions. Support manual dark mode toggle (light + dark themes).

Acceptance Criteria: Mobile layout below 768px; desktop layout at 768px+; tablet uses mobile layout per spec
Cursor Prompt: Implement responsive layout utilities for Grip Kitchen. Breakpoint: 768px. Below 768px use mobile layout (bottom tabs + FAB). At 768px+ use desktop layout (sidebar). IMPORTANT: tablets at 768px+ still use mobile layout (bottom tabs + FAB) per product spec — only wider desktop views get sidebar + spreadsheet.

Task: Create shared UI component library foundation
Acceptance Criteria: Reusable Button, Card, Input, Badge, Text components exist with dark mode support
Cursor Prompt: Create a shared UI component library for Grip Kitchen matching our design system: bold modern + neutral mono base, soft rounded cards with light shadows, spacious mobile spacing, dense desktop spacing. Components needed: Button (primary accent + ghost), Card, Input, Badge (status colors), Text/Heading, IconButton, EmptyState (text + CTA only, no illustrations). All must support dark mode.

Task: Set up mobile navigation (bottom tabs + FAB)
Acceptance Criteria: 5 tabs visible on mobile; FAB present; FAB action is context-aware per tab
Cursor Prompt: Implement mobile navigation for Grip Kitchen: bottom tab bar with tabs for Today, Pantry, Recipes, Planner, Shop. Add a floating action button (FAB) that is context-aware: Today=quick add meal note, Pantry=add inventory item, Recipes=add recipe, Planner=add meal to plan, Shop=add item to shopping list. Use spacious touch targets and tap-only interactions (no swipe gestures).

Acceptance Criteria: Sidebar ~240px with icons + labels; all main sections accessible
Cursor Prompt: Implement desktop navigation for Grip Kitchen: persistent left sidebar (~240px) with icons + labels for Today, Pantry, Recipes, Planner, Shop, Settings. Use dense/pro information density on desktop content areas. Sidebar should only appear on desktop-width views per our breakpoint rules.

Acceptance Criteria: App loads in browser; basic navigation works on mobile and desktop widths
Cursor Prompt: Verify the Grip Kitchen Expo web build runs correctly. Test navigation at 375px (phone), 768px (tablet — should still show mobile tabs), and 1280px (desktop — should show sidebar). Fix any React Native Web layout issues.

Task: Create Supabase project and env config
Acceptance Criteria: Supabase URL and anon key in .env; client initializes without errors
Cursor Prompt: Set up Supabase integration for Grip Kitchen. Create supabase client config using @supabase/supabase-js. Add .env.example with SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY placeholders. Add typed database helpers structure. Do NOT commit secrets.

Acceptance Criteria: All tables exist; RLS enabled; users only see own data
Cursor Prompt: Create Supabase SQL migration for Grip Kitchen schema with Row Level Security. Tables: users (id UUID refs auth.users, email, created_at), inventory (id, user_id, name, category, quantity, unit_of_measure, price_per_unit, expiration_date, location_id, min_threshold), storage_locations (id, user_id, name, sort_order), recipes (id, user_id, title, instructions, base_serving_size, time_to_cook, dietary_tags text[], hero_image_url), recipe_ingredients (id, recipe_id, inventory_item_id, required_quantity), meal_plan (id, user_id, recipe_id, planned_date, meal_label, target_servings, is_cooked), shopping_list (id, user_id, inventory_item_id, target_quantity, is_purchased), waste_log (id, user_id, inventory_item_id, quantity_wasted, cost_wasted, reason, logged_at), barcode_cache (id, user_id, barcode, inventory_item_id). Enable RLS on all tables.

Acceptance Criteria: Database types match schema; imported across services
Cursor Prompt: Generate TypeScript types for the Grip Kitchen Supabase schema. Create a types/database.ts file with all table Row/Insert/Update types. Export helper types for InventoryItem, Recipe, MealPlanEntry, ShoppingListItem, etc.

Acceptance Criteria: User can sign in with Google; session persists; sign out works
Cursor Prompt: Implement Google OAuth authentication for Grip Kitchen using Supabase Auth. Create login screen: minimal centered card on gray background (Notion-style) with logo, tagline, and single Continue with Google button. Handle auth state in root layout — redirect unauthenticated users to login. Add sign out in Settings.

Task: Create user profile on first sign-in
Acceptance Criteria: New Google users get a row in users table automatically
Cursor Prompt: Implement automatic user profile creation for Grip Kitchen on first Google sign-in. Use a Supabase trigger or client-side upsert to insert into users table with id and email from auth.users.

Acceptance Criteria: Two test accounts cannot see each other's data
Cursor Prompt: Test Supabase auth and RLS for Grip Kitchen. Verify authenticated queries work and unauthenticated access is blocked. Document how to test RLS with two accounts.

Acceptance Criteria: Converts g↔kg, ml↔L; handles flexible custom units with best-effort conversion
Cursor Prompt: Create a unit conversion utility for Grip Kitchen. Support metric units (g, kg, ml, L, each). Handle flexible custom unit names with best-effort conversion. This is critical for recipe scaling and inventory deduction — a recipe calling for 200g must correctly deduct from inventory tracked in kg.

Acceptance Criteria: Formula works: (newServings / baseServings) * requiredQuantity; used in UI and deduction logic
Cursor Prompt: Implement dynamic recipe scaling for Grip Kitchen. Formula: (New Servings / Base Servings) * Required Quantity. Create a useRecipeScaling hook and utility functions. Scaling must apply in recipe UI, meal plan target_servings, and auto-deduction logic.

Acceptance Criteria: Per-ingredient cost, total meal cost, and per-serving cost calculated in AUD
Cursor Prompt: Create cost calculation utilities for Grip Kitchen in AUD. Calculate per-ingredient cost (scaled quantity * price_per_unit), total meal cost, and per-serving cost. Handle unit conversion when computing costs. Format currency as AUD ($).

Acceptance Criteria: User can create, rename, reorder, delete custom storage locations in Settings
Cursor Prompt: Implement storage locations CRUD for Grip Kitchen. Users manage custom locations (Pantry, Fridge, Freezer, etc.) in Settings. Support create, rename, reorder (sort_order), and delete. Assign location when adding/editing inventory items.

Acceptance Criteria: Full CRUD for inventory; category field; min_threshold per item; expiration_date; price_per_unit
Cursor Prompt: Build inventory management hooks/services for Grip Kitchen. CRUD operations for inventory items with fields: name, category (Produce, Pantry, Dairy, etc.), quantity, unit_of_measure, price_per_unit (AUD), expiration_date, location_id, min_threshold (per-item reorder threshold). Create useInventory hook with React Query or similar.

Acceptance Criteria: Spacious list with location filter tabs; inline expiry color highlighting; tap to edit
Cursor Prompt: Build the mobile Pantry view for Grip Kitchen. Spacious list layout with location filter tabs at top (from storage_locations). Color-code rows for expiry status (amber=expiring soon, red=expired, green=in stock). Tap-only to open edit. Include per-tab search. Empty state: text + CTA button only.

Acceptance Criteria: Full spreadsheet with inline cell editing, sortable columns, bulk select/delete
Cursor Prompt: Build the desktop Pantry spreadsheet for Grip Kitchen. Full spreadsheet with columns: name, category, location, quantity, unit, price/unit, expiration, min threshold, status. Inline cell editing (click cell to edit). Sortable columns. Bulk select and delete. Dense/pro density. Color-coded expiry rows.

Acceptance Criteria: Form works on mobile and desktop; location picker; category picker; min threshold field
Cursor Prompt: Create add/edit inventory item form for Grip Kitchen. Fields: name, category, quantity, unit, price per unit (AUD), expiration date, storage location, min threshold. Works on both mobile (full screen) and desktop (modal or panel). Validate units.

Acceptance Criteria: Recipes link ingredients to inventory items via recipe_ingredients join table
Cursor Prompt: Build recipe CRUD for Grip Kitchen. Recipe fields: title, instructions, base_serving_size, time_to_cook, dietary_tags (predefined presets + custom tags), hero_image_url. Ingredient linking UI: select inventory items and set required_quantity. Join table recipe_ingredients maps recipes to inventory.

Acceptance Criteria: Mobile: 2-column photo grid. Desktop: grid or list with filters. Detail shows scaled ingredients, stock status, cost breakdown
Cursor Prompt: Build recipe list and detail views for Grip Kitchen. Mobile: two-column grid with hero photos (spacious cards). Desktop: grid with dense metadata. Recipe detail: serving size scaler, ingredient list mapped to inventory with in-stock (green) vs missing (red) highlighting, full per-ingredient AUD cost breakdown, total and per-serving cost. Filters: time to cook, dietary tags, cook with X ingredient (reverse lookup).

Acceptance Criteria: Single long scrollable form with live stock check and cost preview
Cursor Prompt: Build the desktop recipe create/edit form for Grip Kitchen as a single long scrollable page. Sections: basics, hero photo, ingredients (link to inventory), instructions, dietary tags. Show live preview of scaled cost and stock availability as user edits.

Acceptance Criteria: Upload from camera/gallery, paste URL, auto-pull from URL import
Cursor Prompt: Implement recipe hero photo handling for Grip Kitchen. Support: camera/gallery upload to Supabase Storage, paste image URL, and auto-pull hero image when importing recipe from URL. Photos required on recipe cards.

Acceptance Criteria: Can create inventory, create recipe linked to inventory, see stock status on recipe
Cursor Prompt: Test Grip Kitchen CRUD flows end-to-end. Create inventory items, create a recipe linking those items, verify stock highlighting and cost breakdown on recipe detail. Test scaling servings and verify quantities update.

Task: Mark recipe as cooked — auto-deduct inventory
Acceptance Criteria: Atomic transaction subtracts scaled quantities; meal_plan.is_cooked = true
Cursor Prompt: Implement onMarkRecipeCooked for Grip Kitchen as an atomic operation (Supabase RPC or Edge Function preferred). Steps: 1) Fetch meal_plan + recipe, 2) Fetch recipe_ingredients, 3) Calculate scaled quantities from target_servings, 4) Subtract from inventory (with unit conversion), 5) Set is_cooked=true. Full deduct always (no partial serving prompt).

Acceptance Criteria: Checking off items and completing shop adds target_quantity to inventory
Cursor Prompt: Implement shopping list completion for Grip Kitchen. When user checks off items (is_purchased=true) and completes the shop, add target_quantity to corresponding inventory items. Handle new items not yet in inventory (prompt to create). Reset or archive completed list.

Acceptance Criteria: Auto-generates from meal plan gaps + per-item min_threshold shortfalls
Cursor Prompt: Implement smart shopping list generator for Grip Kitchen. Auto-generate items from: (1) out-of-stock ingredients needed for upcoming meal plans, and (2) items below their per-item min_threshold. Allow manual add/remove anytime. Group list by category (Produce, Dairy, Pantry, etc.).

Acceptance Criteria: Rapid qty adjustment UI; set qty to 0 with reason Wasted logs waste
Cursor Prompt: Implement Stocktake mode for Grip Kitchen. Rapid-entry UI for manual inventory corrections (tap +/- or inline edit quantities). When setting qty to 0, offer reason dropdown including Wasted — which logs to waste_log with cost_wasted calculated from price_per_unit. Accessible from Pantry tab and context-aware FAB.

Acceptance Criteria: Background check flags items approaching expiration; inline pantry highlighting
Cursor Prompt: Implement expiration alert logic for Grip Kitchen. Background check (on app load + periodic) for items approaching expiration_date. Display as inline color-coded pantry rows (amber=soon, red=expired). In-app only — no push notifications. Show expiring items summary on Today dashboard.

Acceptance Criteria: Recipe view accurately shows in-stock vs missing based on scaled quantities
Cursor Prompt: Implement ingredient stock checking for Grip Kitchen. For each recipe ingredient, compare scaled required_quantity against inventory quantity (with unit conversion). Highlight in-stock (green) vs missing (red). No substitution suggestions — missing only.

Task: Verify inventory deduction and addition flows
Acceptance Criteria: Cook a meal → inventory decreases. Complete shop → inventory increases. Units convert correctly.
Cursor Prompt: Test Grip Kitchen advanced logic. Mark a meal as cooked and verify inventory deduction with correct scaling and unit conversion. Complete a shopping trip and verify inventory addition. Test stocktake waste logging. Test shopping list auto-generation from meal plan + low stock.

Acceptance Criteria: Shows today's planned meals first, expiring items summary below, quick links
Cursor Prompt: Build the Today dashboard for Grip Kitchen — mobile home screen. Priority layout: today's planned meals (from meal_plan) with mark-as-cooked action, expiring items summary below, quick links to Shop and Pantry. This is the default landing tab on mobile.

Acceptance Criteria: Compact dashboard with today's meals, expiring items, shopping list preview
Cursor Prompt: Build the desktop Today dashboard for Grip Kitchen. Dense layout: today's meals, expiring items table, upcoming meal plan snippet, shopping list preview. Sidebar navigation visible.

Acceptance Criteria: Calendar grid with recipe chips per day; flexible meals per day
Cursor Prompt: Build meal planner month view for Grip Kitchen. Calendar grid showing planned meals as chips on each day. Support flexible number of meals per day (not fixed B/L/D slots). Drag/drop or tap to assign recipes. Show target_servings per entry.

Acceptance Criteria: 7-day column view with meal entries; assign recipes to days
Cursor Prompt: Build meal planner week view for Grip Kitchen. 7-column week layout with meal entries per day. Assign recipes with serving count. Mark as cooked from this view.

Acceptance Criteria: Scrollable upcoming meals list sorted by date
Cursor Prompt: Build meal planner agenda/list view for Grip Kitchen. Scrollable list of upcoming planned meals sorted by date. Compact rows with recipe name, date, servings, cooked status.

Acceptance Criteria: Category-grouped checklist; tap to check off; manual add/remove; complete shop button
Cursor Prompt: Build the Shop tab for Grip Kitchen. Category-grouped checklist (Produce, Dairy, Pantry, etc.). Tap-only check-off (no swipe). Manual add/remove items. Complete Shop button triggers inventory addition. Show auto-generated vs manual items. Per-tab search.

Acceptance Criteria: Dark mode toggle, AUD currency, locations, categories, unit prefs, export, account delete, sign out
Cursor Prompt: Build full Settings page for Grip Kitchen. Include: dark mode toggle (manual, not system), currency display (AUD fixed), storage locations management, default categories, unit preferences (metric), data export (CSV/JSON), account delete, sign out. Subtle PWA install hint here.

Acceptance Criteria: Each tab has its own search filtering relevant data
Cursor Prompt: Implement per-tab search for Grip Kitchen (no global Cmd+K). Today: search meals. Pantry: search inventory. Recipes: search + filter by time, diet, ingredient. Planner: search planned meals. Shop: search list items.

Acceptance Criteria: Manual toggle persists; all screens support light and dark themes
Cursor Prompt: Implement manual dark mode toggle for Grip Kitchen across all screens and components. Persist preference in local storage or user settings. Verify contrast and status colors work in both themes.

Acceptance Criteria: Gentle fades and slide transitions throughout app
Cursor Prompt: Add subtle animations to Grip Kitchen: gentle fade transitions between screens, slide for modals/panels, satisfying check-off feedback on shopping list. Keep animations minimal for speed.

Acceptance Criteria: Text + CTA button on every empty tab; no illustrations
Cursor Prompt: Add empty states to all Grip Kitchen tabs. Text description + single CTA button only (no illustrations). Examples: No pantry items yet → Add your first item. No recipes → Add or import a recipe. No meal plan → Plan your first meal.

Acceptance Criteria: All 5 tabs functional on mobile and desktop; design system consistent
Cursor Prompt: Walk through all Grip Kitchen screens at mobile (375px) and desktop (1280px) widths. Verify design system consistency: bold modern mono, soft rounded cards, status colors, spacious mobile, dense desktop. Fix layout bugs.

Acceptance Criteria: Paste URL → parse title, ingredients, instructions, hero image → review → save
Cursor Prompt: Implement recipe URL import for Grip Kitchen with best-effort scraping. User pastes a URL, app attempts to extract title, ingredients list, instructions, and hero image. Show review screen before saving. Map scraped ingredients to existing inventory items. Auto-pull hero image when available.

Acceptance Criteria: Mobile camera scans barcode → Open Food Facts lookup → prefill name/category → add to inventory or shop list
Cursor Prompt: Implement barcode scanning for Grip Kitchen mobile PWA. Use device camera to scan barcode, query Open Food Facts API for product name and category suggestion, prefill add-item form. Allow adding to inventory or shopping list. Cache barcode mappings in barcode_cache table for reuse.

Acceptance Criteria: Setting qty to 0 with reason Wasted creates waste_log entry with cost
Cursor Prompt: Implement waste logging for Grip Kitchen through stocktake mode. When user sets inventory quantity to 0 and selects reason Wasted, create waste_log entry with quantity_wasted and cost_wasted (from price_per_unit). No separate waste report page for v1.

Acceptance Criteria: Predefined tags available; user can add custom tags; filter recipes by tags
Cursor Prompt: Implement dietary tags for Grip Kitchen. Provide predefined presets (Vegetarian, Vegan, Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, Keto, etc.) plus allow custom freeform tags. Use tags in recipe filter on Recipes tab.

Acceptance Criteria: Web app manifest, icons, installable; subtle install hint in Settings
Cursor Prompt: Configure Grip Kitchen as an installable PWA. Add web manifest, app icons, theme colors matching design system. Subtle install hint in Settings only (no aggressive banner). Verify Add to Home Screen works on iOS and Android.

Acceptance Criteria: Export inventory and recipes as CSV/JSON from Settings
Cursor Prompt: Implement data export in Grip Kitchen Settings. Export inventory and recipes as CSV or JSON download. Include all user data fields.

Task: Test URL import and barcode flows
Acceptance Criteria: URL import parses a real recipe site; barcode scan returns Open Food Facts data
Cursor Prompt: Test Grip Kitchen URL import with 2-3 real recipe URLs. Test barcode scanning with a known product barcode and verify Open Food Facts lookup and form prefill.

Acceptance Criteria: g↔kg, ml↔L, custom units, zero quantities handled without crashes
Cursor Prompt: Write and run tests for Grip Kitchen unit conversion edge cases. Verify: 200g deducts from 1kg correctly, ml/L conversions, custom unit names, zero/negative quantity guards.

Acceptance Criteria: Fractional servings, double/triple recipes, single serving all work
Cursor Prompt: Test Grip Kitchen recipe scaling with edge cases: 0.5 servings, 2x, 3x base recipe. Verify UI and deduction logic match.

Acceptance Criteria: Concurrent cook + stocktake doesn't corrupt data; RPC is atomic
Cursor Prompt: Test Grip Kitchen inventory transaction integrity. Verify mark-as-cooked RPC is atomic. Test concurrent stocktake adjustments don't corrupt quantities.

Acceptance Criteria: Works in Chrome, Safari, Firefox on mobile and desktop
Cursor Prompt: Test Grip Kitchen web build in Chrome, Safari (iOS), and Firefox at mobile and desktop widths. Fix any compatibility issues.

Acceptance Criteria: Session survives page refresh; expired session redirects to login
Cursor Prompt: Test Grip Kitchen auth session persistence across page refresh and tab close/reopen. Verify expired sessions redirect to login gracefully.

Acceptance Criteria: 375px, 768px, 1280px layouts all correct; tablet uses mobile nav
Cursor Prompt: Regression test Grip Kitchen responsive layouts at 375px, 768px, and 1280px. Confirm tablet (768px) uses mobile tabs + FAB not sidebar.

Task: Configure Expo web export for Vercel
Acceptance Criteria: expo export:web produces static output; vercel.json routes configured
Cursor Prompt: Configure Grip Kitchen for Vercel deployment. Set up expo export:web output targeting. Create vercel.json with correct rewrites for Expo Router SPA routing. Document build command.

Acceptance Criteria: Vercel project created; env vars set; deploy succeeds
Cursor Prompt: Deploy Grip Kitchen to Vercel. Set environment variables: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY. Verify production build deploys successfully.

Acceptance Criteria: Google OAuth redirect URLs include production Vercel domain
Cursor Prompt: Configure Supabase Auth for Grip Kitchen production. Add Vercel production URL to Google OAuth redirect URIs and Supabase allowed redirect URLs.

Acceptance Criteria: Storage bucket created with RLS; photo upload works in production
Cursor Prompt: Set up Supabase Storage bucket for Grip Kitchen recipe photos. Configure RLS policies so users can only access their own uploads. Test upload in production.

Acceptance Criteria: Login, CRUD, cook, shop, PWA install all work on live URL
Cursor Prompt: Run production smoke test on deployed Grip Kitchen. Test: Google login, add inventory, create recipe, plan meal, mark cooked (deduct), generate shop list, complete shop (add), PWA install from Settings hint.

Acceptance Criteria: README with setup steps, env vars, and run commands
Cursor Prompt: Create README.md for Grip Kitchen with: project overview, local dev setup (npm install, env vars, expo start), Supabase setup steps, deployment notes, and architecture summary.
